label: Issue 1 — the audit
thesis: Whether she will sign what she knows is false

scenes.accomplishes: The auditor arrives unannounced and asks for the ledger she keeps privately
scenes.changes: the private ledger is now known to exist
scenes.sets_up: she has to decide what to hand over

scenes.accomplishes: She hands over a copy she has edited

follows_from.text: the ledger is now known to exist

scenes.accomplishes: The auditor asks for the original

follows_from.text: she handed over an edited copy

scenes.changes: the falsification is now at risk of discovery
scenes.sets_up: she needs someone to destroy the original

cliffhanger.event: She asks him to burn the original, in the room where the auditor is still working
cliffhanger.issue2Predicament: She has made a second person into an accomplice, and he has not said yes. Issue 2 opens with her owing him something she cannot name and the auditor one room away.
